root_cause: After the original async preflight claim, a database trigger overwrites updated_at with DB now(); the original background failure reporter used caller claimedAt in a strict CAS and silently matched zero rows, losing the real provider 503 evidence.
prevention: Use DB-returned updated_at from SELECT id,updated_at on original claim for subsequent async failure CAS. Always use UPDATE RETURNING and distinguish zero-row stale/concurrent proof from recorded failure. Never replace actual PASS or real measured rejection.
guardrails: Same original job and video, no new OpenArt generation
No fake face PASS or lost provider error
Preserve 0.940 face, temporal, exact media and Meta readback gates
CAS readback with database timestamp, not caller clock
